An anchor split around a block keeps the half that carries its text

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<a href="/o">Text<div><a href="/i">Inner</a></div></a>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
